g.text: Saved split-aggregate anchor at 2100 s (35 min) · 16 coordinates × six diagnostic protocols

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #334155

g.text: Left reference increments: 1% fractional differential for the 11 parameters; 1 SOC percentage point for z; 1 mV for each v; 0.01 for h.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #334155

g.text: Right: finite, known post-inference errors. Shared colour scale is in mV; grey dashes are exact zero; annotations are rounded.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: Peaks use the full declared 35 Hz diagnostic grid, including the initial point. Pre-anchor history is not recomputed.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #475569

g.text: These are forward model diagnostics: no voltage assimilation, uncertainty coverage, or continuous-time bound is claimed.
